# The Radar Keeps Moving

Version 1.4.1 fixes a radar that stopped updating as soon as a tracker started to move while the moving animation was switched on.

## Fixes

- **The chart keeps updating when a tracker starts moving.** _[#72]_ With `moving_animation_enabled`, the card drew a ping circle under every tracker that is walking or driving, but adding that circle failed once the dots were already on the radar. The first time a tracker's activity changed to Walking or Driving after the card had loaded, the chart froze: dots stayed where they were while the legend kept updating, until the page was reloaded. The ping now appears under the moving dot and the dots follow their trackers again.

## If you already use the card

Nothing to change. Update and reload the page; your configuration carries over.
